art_direction: 弯曲椭圆眼外侧略压扁，双瞳向左上，留白像较宽的水滴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two bent horizontal ovals whose outer sides flatten a little under marker pressure. Let the inner upper curves stay fuller. Both broad pupils turn toward the upper left, holding large uneven teardrop paper reserves. Avoid separate circular iris discs: fit the flat iris accents into the remaining opening around each pupil. One lower marker curve ends with a short blunt stop, the other with a faint taper. Keep the paired eyes balanced and isolated on pale paper, without brows or mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
